component.name: Vito
component.summary: Voice In, Text Out — dictate anywhere with a hotkey
Voice In, Text Out — overal dicteren met een sneltoets

description.p: Vito turns speech into finished text wherever your cursor is. Press your hotkey, speak, and the transcript is cleaned up and pasted into whatever you were working in — an editor, a chat, a form.
It uses your own API keys for speech recognition (AssemblyAI or Soniox) and, optionally, for the AI cleanup pass. Your settings, dictionary and history stay on your own machine.
